title: Zero-step survival probability equals one
statement: For every state $s$ — a multigraph $G$ together with a distinguished cut $C$ of $G$ — the recursive survival probability of the distinguished cut over zero random edge-occurrence choices equals $1$.
hypotheses_covered: s is a state (a multigraph with a distinguished cut)
the number of steps is zero
replaced: With no remaining contractions the survival probability is $1$.
